import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    return p[0]*P*(1-P/p[1]) + p[2]*np.sin(p[3]*t+p[4])*P + p[5]*np.sin(p[6]*t+p[7]) + p[8]*t + p[9]
